svg.title: SpaceX Cumulative Payload Mass Launched by Year
svg.desc: Line chart of the cumulative payload mass SpaceX launched over each year from 2017 to 2026, one line per year on a shared calendar. Year-end totals: 2025 2,190,555 kg, 2024 1,656,798 kg, 2023 1,168,570 kg. 2026 reached 1,571,380 kg by 26 November. Data: Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0, launches through 24 November 2026. 67 successful launches with unknown or classified payload mass count as 0 kg.
